cohort: 219 pregnancies complicated with PPH (blood loss > 500 mL, irrespective of the mode of delivery) out of 8545 births at the Third Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Aristotle University of Thessaloniki, Greece, from 2015 to 2021
finding: The rate of primary postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) was 2.5%, with advanced maternal age (> 35 years), prematurity (<37 weeks), and multiparity identified as significant risk factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with a higher need for multiple treatment modalities for PPH.
